title: Elite: Roots Remember Footsteps: First Pressure
description: Roots Remember Footsteps unfolds across moon-grove rootlabyrinth with braided root walls and soft moss cover, pushing a one active Tuatha Titan to prove adaptation, healing, roots, terrain control, endurance through life systems. without violating established Realm canon.
lore: Roots Remember Footsteps: First Pressure advances Roots Below the Gate: Avalora reveals that Gate wounds can be healed only if living terrain is treated as ally, witness, and battlefield at once. It directly tests the faction tension: Their memory is power, but it can become vengeance when old wounds refuse to compost.
